constraints.expression: permitted_sub_goals values MUST be distinct — no two entries in the permitted_sub_goals array may be the same string.
constraints.message: permitted_sub_goals MUST NOT contain duplicate sub-goals.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by the registered cross-field validator validateScopeOfAutonomy (src/governance/scope-of-autonomy.ts), so validate() rejects duplicates. Stated in narrative form because the DSL builtin unique_values(array, field) compares a named field of object elements and permitted_sub_goals is an array of strings. Cross-language runners that implement only the structural tier treat the invalid-cross-field fixture as pass-cross-field-deferred.

constraints.message: An ending condition of kind 'time_limit' MUST carry ending_condition.latest_time.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by validateScopeOfAutonomy at validate() time.

constraints.message: expires_at, when present, MUST be strictly after issued_at.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by validateScopeOfAutonomy at validate() time. Compares instants (offset-aware), not strings. Whether the scope has expired relative to a clock is NOT checked here (SOA-N2); use evaluateScopeActivity(scope, now).

constraints.message: A requested stop MUST record stop_work.requested_at.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by validateScopeOfAutonomy at validate() time.

constraints.message: ending_condition.latest_time MUST NOT be after expires_at.
constraints.evaluation_note: Library-evaluated by validateScopeOfAutonomy at validate() time. Equal instants are allowed.

constraints.expression: consumer resolves the parent scope named by parent_scope_id and evaluates that the child scope is within it: evaluateScopeInheritance(child, parent).within_parent
constraints.message: A child scope MUST be within its parent scope: sub-goals, cost, wall clock, data access, tools, latest_time and expires_at no wider than the parent's, and a parent stop-work request carried through.
constraints.evaluation_note: Cross-record: the parent scope is consumer state. The consumer MUST run evaluateScopeInheritance(child, parent) with the resolved parent (src/governance/scope-of-autonomy-eval.ts), or pass it as validate(ScopeOfAutonomySchema, child, { scopeContext: { parent_scope } }). Without the parent, validate() emits a manifest entry with evaluator 'consumer' and reason 'scope_parent_context_deferred'; with the parent, violations return valid: false plus entries with reason 'scope_inheritance_violation'. Root scopes (no parent_scope_id) carry no SOA-6 obligation.

constraints.expression: consumer evaluates that principal_id holds the authority to grant this scope to agent_id
constraints.message: The principal MUST be authorized to grant the scope to the agent. The library does NOT adjudicate grant authority.
constraints.evaluation_note: Consumer authority per ADR-010. principal_id and agent_id are opaque to the library; resolving them to identities and deciding whether the grant is permitted is the consumer's policy decision. validate() never evaluates this rule.
